integrity: The argument is analytic and uses the focal source's exact symbolic inclusion together with the ergodic theorem. No numerical experiment, independent audit, or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Conditional on an ergodic invariant probability equivalent to Lebesgue measure; stated for 0<a<c; no general existence theorem for such a measure and no Hausdorff-dimension transfer are claimed.
title: Equivalent invariant measure removes the pullback-null condition for decreasing Lorenz entropy staircases
